WYLDER-WYLDER.cardsModifierDescription: The Wylder's cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
WYLDER-WYLDER.description:
A youth who ceaselessly tracks the Night King.
Blessed with an extraordinary sixth sense, a swordsman who has walked through countless life-and-death trials.
His clan was slaughtered; to lay their restless spirits to rest, he set out to hunt down the Night.
WYLDER-WYLDER.eventDeathPrevention: I still have to keep waiting...
WYLDER-WYLDER.title: The Wylder
WYLDER-WYLDER.unlockText: Play a run with [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
WYLDER-RECLUSE.cardsModifierDescription: The Recluse's cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
WYLDER-RECLUSE.description:
A witch who walks the edge of forbidden arts.
Wielding power far beyond ordinary mortals, yet content to dwell in corners the world has forgotten.
The Night devoured her last refuge; to seal that boundless darkness, she set forth once more.
WYLDER-RECLUSE.eventDeathPrevention: I haven't finished the final incantation...
WYLDER-RECLUSE.title: The Recluse
WYLDER-RECLUSE.unlockText: Play a run with [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
